name: BKI Holdings Public Company Limited
summary: BKI Holdings Public Company Limited engages in the provision of non-life insurance in Thailand. It operates through Motor, Non-motor, Total insurance segments, and Others segments. The company offers travel accident, personal accident, motor, health, property, third party liability, business all risks, engineering, marine and cargo, aviation, transportation, and miscellaneous insurance products, as well as insurance for homes, shops, and business establishments. BKI Holdings Public Company Limited was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
